description: This file defines the Java class 'ThingErrorResponse', which represents an error response to a 'ThingCommand' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from exceptions and JSON, and for serialization/deserialization of error details related to 'Thing' entities.

classes.name: ThingErrorResponse
classes.description: Represents an error response for a 'Thing' command, encapsulating exceptions and related information. Provides serialization/deserialization support and static factory methods for creation from exceptions and JSON.

methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of 'ThingErrorResponse' from exceptions, ThingId, headers, or JSON representations.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of 'ThingErrorResponse' from a JSON string or JSON object, reconstructing the exception details.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path, which is empty for error response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and filtering predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new 'ThingErrorResponse' with the specified headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on super, thingId, and exception.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering class type, thingId, exception, and super equality.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of 'ThingErrorResponse' for equality purposes.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including class name, thingId, and exception details.
